what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 1 of 3: The no-memory region under light-cone formation with the true influence constant. GIVEN: two attempts claimed uniqueness for beta < 3/7 from ||Cov_vMF|| <= 1/3; the referee showed the step FAILS: the covariance bound makes the MEAN map (beta/3)-Lipschitz, but the Dobrushin/Wasserstein influence of one predecessor is the W1-Lipschitz constant of S -> vMF(beta S) (the sup over 1-Lipschitz f of Cov(f, u.s)), which the covariance does not control. Block 27 (PR #8171) has the total-variation sensitivity |V - V'|/(2 sqrt 3). TASK: the correct region. (a) Compute or bound the W1 influence of the vMF kernel exactly (at V = 0 the law is uniform: the optimal transport between vMF(V) and vMF(V') is explicit to first order); (b) give the uniqueness region for 7 predecessors by total variation (block 27: 7 beta/sqrt 3 < 1?) and by W1, and say which is larger; (c) compare with the executed onset of memory (between beta = 0.6 and 0.75 on 32^3 planes). Exact finite checks of every constant. ROUND 2: the first round's attempts and referee reports are under probes/work/derive/<problem>/ and logs/probes/J:derive:*/ and logs/probes/J:confirm:J-derive-*/ (python3 probes/harvest.py lists them); what survived refereeing is stated below as GIVEN, what failed is stated as the gap. DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/lightcone-uniqueness-region/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/derive/lightcone-uniqueness-region/<name>/check.py"

triage.note: The run demonstrates what it claims and nothing more. check.py's 33 assertions are sympy identities or rational-interval computations with outward rounding; the only numerical item (the k^2 coefficient, by mpmath quadrature) is labelled and is used by no other check. What is established: the parallel W1 influence of the vMF kernel is at most the cost of an explicit antitone transport plan on the meridians (any coupling is an upper bound, so no optimality is needed), that cost has a closed form because M(z) = Mmax - c*omega(k(z-A)) makes the pairing k-free in zeta = k(z-A), Phi(0) = 1/3 exactly, and Phi(k) < A(k)/k at 14 certified k in [1/10,3] with the margin k^2/27 + O(k^4) at the origin. What is NOT established, and is stated as such in ATTEMPT.md section 3: the inequality between the certified k, the range k < 1/10 (no finite certificate can work there, since the margin vanishes quadratically), and the mixed directions of the directional lemma, so the proved region stays 3/10 and 3/7 stays conditional. The prior attempt a2 on this problem is by the same model family and the same machine; that is disclosed in the attempt, and the one number taken from it (its grid LP optima 0.3297/0.2825/0.1896) is used only as a cross-check, which my independent cost function reproduces as 0.329665/0.282117/0.189619.
